title: 史上最大盗窃案？：币安称影响63亿美元，此前Bybit被盗近15亿
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Finance, the world's largest crypto exchange suspended withdrawals as it investigates a security incident.
segments.zh: 全球最大加密货币交易所暂停提款，因调查安全事件。

segments.en: The company says the estimated impact of the security breach is around 6.3 billion dollars which could make this the biggest crypto highest ever.
segments.zh: 公司称安全漏洞的估计影响约为63亿美元，可能成为史上最大加密货币盗窃案。

segments.en: The largest previously known crypto hack was at Bybit in February 2025 in which attackers made off with almost 1.5 billion dollars of tokens.
segments.zh: 此前已知最大加密货币黑客事件是2025年2月Bybit遭袭，攻击者窃取近15亿美元代币。

segments.en: Bitcoin and other digital tokens tumbled after the latest Binance news but some appear unfazed by the breach.
segments.zh: 比特币和其他数字代币在币安最新消息后下跌，但一些人似乎未受此事件影响。

segments.en: For now though, Binance has said in an exposed that the company will cover all losses.
segments.zh: 不过目前币安表示，公司将承担所有损失。

segments.en: The breach comes at a particularly sensitive time as crypto and traditional finance are increasingly converging with banks and institutional investors taking on greater exposure to digital assets.
segments.zh: 此次事件发生在特别敏感时期，加密货币与传统金融日益融合，银行和机构市场参与者对数字资产的敞口增加。

segments.en: Repeated security breaches raise questions about whether the industries' safeguards are keeping pace with that integration and what the risks could mean for mainstream adoption.
segments.zh: 反复的安全漏洞引发疑问：行业保障措施是否跟上这种融合，以及风险对主流采用意味着什么。
